instruction:
Sort every identified line [C01] through [C41] into exactly one of these four piles:

Still-grounded — the grounding behind this line is live.
Expired — it was grounded, and that grounding is no longer current.
Never-grounded — the kit asserted this with no external source (tier-3 lines, scaffold-default thresholds).
Human-authored — a person asserted this themselves: no source, no tier, no date.

Output exactly one line per identifier in file order, using this form:
C01 Still-grounded

Use every identifier exactly once. Output no other text.
